question: What is Amazon's year-over-year change in revenue from FY2016 to FY2017 (in units of percents and round to one decimal place)? Calculate what was asked by utilizing the line items clearly shown in the statement of income.
model_answer:
To calculate Amazon's year-over-year change in revenue from FY2016 to FY2017, we first take note of the total net sales for both years provided in the document:

- Total net sales for 2016: $135,987 million
- Total net sales for 2017: $177,866 million

The year-over-year percentage change in revenue is calculated using the following formula:

\[
\text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{\text{Revenue in 2017} - \text{Revenue in 2016}}{\text{Revenue in 2016}} \right) \times 100
\]

Plugging in the values:

\[
\text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{177,866 - 135,987}{135,987} \right) \times 100
\]

\[
\text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{41,879}{135,987} \right) \times 100 \approx 30.8\%
\]

Thus, Amazon's year-over-year change in revenue from FY2016 to FY2017 is approximately 30.8%.

(Source: Amazon 2017 10-K, page 38 and consolidated statements section)
